title: Hundreds of delays, dozens of cancellations at Logan amid heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Logan Airport experienced 493 flight delays and 73 cancellations due to heavy rain across the region.
JetBlue and Republic Airways had the most flight delays, with 110 and 100 delays respectively at Logan.
Boston received under an inch of rain, but Central and Western Massachusetts saw over 4 inches, affecting travel.

title: Which trade chips could Red Sox use to acquire another impact bat?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox may trade top prospect Franklin Arias to acquire a big-impact bat before the Aug. 3 MLB trade deadline.
Boston is considering moving young talents like Marcelo Mayer, Payton Tolle, or Jake Bennett to bolster their lineup.
Trading outfielder Roman Anthony appears unlikely, unless a significant star such as Bobby Witt Jr. becomes available.

title: Wellfleet police release plea for help from public in 2025 homicide
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Timothy Duval Jr., 24, was killed by a vehicle in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in May 2025 while on vacation.
Wellfleet Police seek public assistance in an ongoing investigation into Duval's death, considered a homicide.
Authorities have interviewed a dozen witnesses and examined multiple vehicles related to the 2025 incident.

title: New report sheds light on Curtis Mead’s potential return to Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Curtis Mead of the Red Sox reportedly won't require surgery for his broken wrist.
Mead is expected to return in 6-8 weeks; the regular season ends on September 27.
Mead fractured his wrist after being hit by a pitch in his debut against the A's.

title: Hennessy’s in downtown Boston has closed, plans to transfer liquor license to new Seaport restaurant
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Hennessy's Bar in downtown Boston has closed after nearly 30 years at 25 Union St. near Quincy Market.
The bar is transferring its liquor license to Bar 23, a steakhouse opening in Seaport at 11 Fan Pier Blvd. next year.
Hennessy's was a popular Irish pub and World Cup gathering spot, known for live music and themed nights.

title: Framingham remote Logan terminal will be extended through March
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: The Framingham remote Logan terminal, opened June 1, has served 10,000 passengers, MassPort announced.
Delta and JetBlue passengers can use TSA screening at the terminal and take a bus to Logan Airport for $9 each way.
MassPort plans to extend the terminal service through March and intends to expand to other locations and airlines.

title: Sonny Gray reportedly interested in signing extension with Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Sonny Gray expresses interest in extending contract with Boston Red Sox beyond 2026 season.
Gray currently boasts a 12-2 record with a 2.78 ERA and 93 strikeouts in 106.2 innings.
Red Sox's unexpected 18-4 July record strengthens position in playoff race, reducing trade likelihood.

title: Teen driver killed, 4 others hospitalized in stolen SUV crash in Abington
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 17-year-old boy was killed in a stolen Hyundai Santa Fe crash in Abington, police reported.
Four teenagers, aged 14 to 17, were hospitalized with serious injuries after the vehicle struck a tree.
Abington police were tracking the stolen SUV before it veered off-road; the investigation is ongoing.

title: Celtics ‘expressed interest’ in LeBron James in free agency before he joined 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Celtics showed interest in LeBron James during the free agency before he joined the Philadelphia 76ers.
James, 41, signed a two-year deal with the 76ers, joining a roster with Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown.
ESPN reported the Celtics' chances were slim due to LeBron's historical clashes with Boston in playoffs.

title: Parts of Mass. under flash flood warning as state sees heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Flash flood warning in effect until 6 p.m. for Western Massachusetts including Springfield, Chicopee, and Westfield.
Berkshire County faces a flood warning until 5:45 p.m., with potential rainfall totals up to 7 inches.
Central and Western Mass., Eastern Rhode Island, and Connecticut are under flood watch until 8 p.m. due to heavy rain.
